## Review round 2 (2026-09-16) — applying the review findings
- [x] Findings 1/12: ActivationService.ActivateAsync now returns an ActivationResult and refuses before writing anything when the machine already carries an installation (AlreadyActivated) or the disk is full (DiskFull, via the new DiskSpace helper); W02/W03/W04 gained the `if (Login.IsActivated) -> /login` guard W05 already had.
- [x] Finding 2: SetupInspectionService takes AccountSession and exposes ExpectationsAsync(), which supplies PinnedOrgSigningPub / InstalledDeviceId / InstalledExportSeq from the open installation; the device id is kept verbatim in the new setting setup.device_id so the comparison is exact. W02 now inspects against it.
- [x] Finding 3: W05 runs a database-free clock pre-check in OnInitialized (build date, last sign-in) so the chip reports a verdict it reached; ClockCheckService still runs after sign-in and records it.
- [x] Findings 4/9: LoginService/LockService/RecoveryService catch every CryptoException around the key-wrap opens (wrong password counted, anything else -> DatabaseUnreadable / KeysMissing) and zero both key buffers on the failure path.
- [x] Finding 5: W07 verifies the typed code on a worker thread behind a busy flag, dropping a result whose text changed meanwhile.
- [x] Finding 6: W04 keeps the recovery sheet on screen when activation fails and only clears it on success.
- [x] Findings 7/11: W05 omits the identity block and the device number when the sealed card carries no identity; the Caps Lock hint is isolated inside its constant and rendered through <Bdi>.
- [x] Finding 8: LockService honours a standing lock-out, counts wrong passwords through LoginService, and writes the accumulated failures to the audit log when the session opens again.
- [x] Finding 10: WakeelTestContext gives every bUnit test its own temporary installation root and deletes it on dispose.
- [x] Missing item: W07's new recovery sheet now has «طباعة» and «حفظ PDF» (and the sign-in screen behind the dialog is excluded from the print).
- [x] New tests: Walkthrough gained four (second activation refused with the key file byte-identical and the old password/sheet still working; the product's own expectations refusing a file for another machine and an older one; a damaged key file becoming a message rather than an exception; the lock overlay counting, locking out and logging). Wakeel.UI.Tests gained FirstRun/FirstRunGuardTests.cs (eight: the three first-run routes redirecting, the refusal wording, W05 without a readable card, W05 with one, both clock verdicts, the Caps Lock isolate, the printable new sheet).
- [x] Re-verified live: empty --data-folder -> /first-run (W02 screenshot); a folder carrying keys+db but no readable card -> /login, and the screenshot shows no identity block, no «الموظف رقم 0 • الجهاز 0», footer «إصدار الوكيل v0.21» with no device number; navigating to /first-run on that machine lands back on /login with no drop zone. ## Review round 3 (2026-09-16) — applying the review findings
- [x] Medium 1: ActivationService.ActivateAsync is now atomic — a `committed` flag set only after the session adopts the finished installation, and a RollBack that deletes the key file (with its .tmp/.bak siblings) and the database (with -wal/-shm/-journal) on every failure path before the DiskFull result or the rethrow. Walkthrough test proves it: with the database path blocked the attempt throws, keys/installation.key is gone, IsActivated/AlreadyActivated are false, and the same file+sheet+code activate on the second try (verified the test fails when RollBack is disabled).
- [x] Medium 2: RecoveryService.RecoverAsync opens the database FIRST and only then builds the new wraps and saves the key file; a `saved` flag splits the two failure paths, so a failure before the save is DatabaseUnreadable (key file byte-identical) and one after it is the new RecoveredNotSignedIn, which returns the new sheet plus one Arabic sentence instead of a lie. W07 shows that sheet and does not navigate into a workspace that is not open.
- [x] Low 3: W05 re-evaluates the standing lock-out on every keystroke and at the top of SignInAsync, so the «دخول» button returns the moment the wait is over (bUnit test).
- [x] Low 4: LockService.UnlockAsync zeroes machineDbKey/machineVaultKey when _session.Unlock throws.
- [x] Low 5: W07 remembers the text that arrives while a verification is in flight and re-runs the check for it, so the last text typed always gets the verdict (bUnit test drives two texts without waiting).
- [x] Low 6: a missing or unreadable sign-in card on a machine that is already activated no longer resets the wait to the shortest one (SignInProfile.Missing -> LockRounds floor of 1). Residual limit stated in the notes.
- [x] Low 7: recovery codes are counted against the same attempt counter (RecordWrongPassword, de-duplicated so re-checking the same text costs nothing) and both Verify and RecoverAsync refuse while a lock-out stands; new outcome LockedOut with the same wait sentence. Walkthrough test covers the whole cycle.
- [x] Prescribed command green: Desktop 0/0, Walkthrough build 0/0, Walkthrough 18/18, Core 175/175, UI 211/211.
